title: Ashen bindings enter the guarded wardrobe
notes: Set WAR_LAYERED_OUTFIT_PICKERS=1 before launch to equip the ashen bindings in the hands armour slot; the selection now saves and returns on the next load.
The default creator still hides this raw preview. Its flat material lacks cloth grain, stitched seams, and age variation, and the wardrobe controls remain short of the authored equipment screen.
